p: The Directory allows you to download all data contained in different formats. Both the full Business Card data as well as the plain list of all contained participant identifiers are available.
The following rules apply to all the download URLs mentioned on this page:

ul.li: Only HTTP GET requests are supported.

The download URLs don't deliver the data themselves but respond with an HTTP redirect (HTTP status code 302) to the storage location of the respective file. Clients MUST follow the redirect to receive the data.
Clients MUST support gzip compression.
Responses should be cached up to 24 hours.
The data is updated once a day. Exports start at 02:00 a.m. UTC.

div: The usage of the download URLs is rate limited per IP address and per file. By default you are only allowed to download each file 2 times per 24 hours. If you are not following the instructions, the HTTP Status code 429 (Too Many Requests) is returned. In this case you MUST lower your download rate.
p: These exports contain all the indexed Business Card data.

ul.li: The Directory XML data can be downloaded via the URLs /export/businesscards (including all document types) /export/businesscards-xml-no-doc-types (excluding all document types).
The response MIME type is always application/xml.
The XML Schema for the XML responses can be downloaded from /files/directory-export-v3.xsd
The Directory JSON data can be downloaded via the URL /export/businesscards-json.
The response MIME type is always application/json.
The Directory CSV data can be downloaded via the URL /export/businesscards-csv.
The response MIME type is always text/csv.
The CSV file is encoded in ISO-8859-1 character set.

p: These exports contain only the participant identifiers of all indexed participants and no Business Card data at all. All participant identifiers are contained in their URI encoded representation (as in iso6523-actorid-upis::9915:test).

ul.li: The participant identifier XML data can be downloaded via the URL /export/participants-xml.
The response MIME type is always application/xml.

The XML namespace URI is http://www.peppol.eu/schema/pd/participant-generic/201910/. The root element carries the attributes version, creationdt and count and contains one participantID element per participant with the attributes scheme and value.
The participant identifier JSON data can be downloaded via the URL /export/participants-json.
The response MIME type is always application/json.
The top-level object carries the fields version, creationdt and count as well as the array participants with one string per participant.
The participant identifier CSV data can be downloaded via the URL /export/participants-csv.
The response MIME type is always text/csv.
The CSV file is encoded in ISO-8859-1 character set.
